Ownerble Professer $Eunho\;\;LEE$ drink Ethanol solution
with his peers. Ethanol decompose to Citric acid following reaction on river's vessel called $'hepatic\;\;portal\;\;vein'$. Professor's $hepatic\;\;portal\;\;vein$ could assumed as isothermal 100 pipes of pararell PBR reactor. Answer the following questions using given parameters.

$$
\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH+NAD^+} \overset{\mathrm{ADH}}{\rightleftharpoons[k_{-1}]{k_1}} 
\mathrm{CH_3CHO+NADH+H^+}
$$

$$
\mathrm{CH_3CHO+NAD^+ +H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{ALDH\;\;\;k_2}} \mathrm{CH_3COOH+NADH+H^+}
$$

Coenzyme 
$NAD^{+}$ 
and enzyme ADH,ALDH is not included rate expression.

- $C_0= 1mol/dm^3$
- $k_1=10^{-4} s^{-1}gcat^{-1}$
- $k_{-1}=10^{-6} s^{-1}gcat^{-1}$
- $k_2=0.1 s^{-1}gcat{-1}$
- Blood could assumed ethanol-water solution and density is 1g/ml.

$a.$
Korean law defines drunken state over then 0.03wt% of blood alchol concentration(BAC). If Professor's enzyme mass is 0.05g, find feed's maximum flow rate($v_0$) of undrunken state 
as bottle/hr. (1 bottle is 0.36$L$).
